_meta.product_source: /workspace/game/drink_unlocks.json (14 drinks; products.json from Programmer Master not yet present, ids to match)
_meta.tone: Cozy sitcom. Customers are kind. Off drinks get gentle, funny feedback and the customer still pays.
_meta.cameo_note: steve, lamp_lady, keyclackr are the market regulars StaplerSteve88, Lamp_Lady, KeyClackr appearing in person.

legacy_product_ids.iced_lemonade: classic_lemonade (served with extra ice; heat-weather variant)
legacy_product_ids.sweet_coffee: black_coffee + sugar (no longer a menu item; nearest menu drinks: mocha, vanilla_latte)

_meta.gating: A customer appears from appears_from. Until favourite_drink unlocks they order slice_order (e.g. Wren appears at L6 and orders black_coffee until honey_lavender_lemonade unlocks at L8). Orders and banter are only picked when every drink they mention is unlocked.
_meta.event_cast_note: event_cast maps every speaker id (including unused generic ones like queue_npc, regular, narration) to a display name. The roster for one-offs is customers[] with is_regular:false.
_meta.roster_note: customers[] holds the 8 regulars (is_regular: true) and the one-off event cast (22 entries, is_regular: false). Spawners and banter use is_regular entries only. kind: one_off | pet | player | crowd | alias (alias_of names the canonical id). orders:false = never queues or orders.

id_renames._note: Oct 23 (Programmer Master): ids unified. Old -> new. Aliases merged into the canonical entry (no alias rows).

customers.name: Steve (StaplerSteve88)
customers.look: Cardigan, lanyard, a stapler holstered like a sheriff's badge.
customers.personality: The market regular in person. Earnest collector of office supplies, polite to a fault, tips in exact change.
quirks: Rates every drink in staples out of five.
Asks if the cups are stackable.

customers.name: Lorna (Lamp_Lady)
customers.look: Big sunhat, bigger tote bag, always backlit somehow.
customers.personality: The lamp-trading regular. Sunny optimist who describes every drink in terms of lighting.
quirks: Holds cups up to the light before sipping.
customers.pronouns: she/her (explicit: 'Lamp Lady' is her chosen handle)

customers.name: Kit (KeyClackr)
customers.look: Wrist braces, mechanical keyboard in a backpack, typing on the counter.
customers.personality: The keyboard enthusiast. Fast talker, mild typo in everything they say, generous reviewer.
quirks: Drums fingers in actual keyboard rhythms.

customers.name: Dottie Ruiz
customers.look: Retired crossing guard, reflective vest worn 'for fashion now'.
customers.personality: Grandmotherly traffic-controller of the line. Waves everyone forward. Has opinions on lemon wedges.
quirks: Says 'slow down, sweetie' to the espresso machine.
Tells you about her late husband's lemon tree.

customers.name: Theo Nakamura
customers.look: Scrubs, sleepy eyes, comfy sneakers, a single heroic yawn.
customers.personality: Night-shift nurse heading home. Gentle, dry humor, deeply grateful for anything warm.
quirks: Orders a coffee to sleep after, somehow.
Thanks you twice, once for each eye that's open.

customers.name: Pippa Mensah
customers.look: Nine years old, clipboard, sticker-covered glasses.
customers.personality: Junior lemonade critic and future business mogul. Serious notes, enormous smiles.
quirks: Grades with stickers: gold star, silver star, 'nice try' frog.

customers.name: Rocco Delgado
customers.look: Mail carrier shorts in every season, satchel, sunburned nose.
customers.personality: Chatty route-runner who knows every dog by name. Drinks fast, talks faster, never in a bad mood.
quirks: Times his sips to his step counter.

customers.name: Wren Albright
customers.look: Hand-knit scarf, notebook, ink on one finger.
customers.personality: Quiet poet who writes a tiny haiku about every drink. Soft-spoken, notices everything.
quirks: Leaves haiku on napkins as a tip.
Counts the bubbles in the foam.

customers.name: Neighbor kid
customers.description: Kid from next door with a fistful of quarters; the very first customer.

customers.name: Dana (player character)
customers.description: The player. Listed so event lines can name Dana as a speaker; never queues or orders.

customers.name: Priya Okafor
customers.description: Owner of the Whisker & Bean cat cafe. Debuts in her L2 pink-lemonade event (with Biscuit), then comes back as a regular-for-a-day after great serves.

customers.name: Biscuit (the cat)
customers.description: The Whisker & Bean cat. Wanders in, sniffs cups, never orders.

customers.name: Soggy cyclist
customers.description: Drenched cyclist from the L3 rainy drive who shelters at the stand.

customers.name: Grandpa Walt Hale
customers.description: Retired conductor from the L4 train shop; strawberry lemonade fan and caboose collector.

customers.name: Duckling
customers.description: A very small duck at the L5 pond. Waddles, quacks, does not drink lemonade.

customers.name: Delbert Finch
customers.description: Retired watchmaker in the bakery loft building. Times every coffee to the second.

customers.name: Dr. Barry Plum
customers.description: Cheerful dentist on his last day at the L7 office; espresso, no sugar, 'for professional reasons'.

customers.name: Gerald (the fish)
customers.description: The dentist's goldfish and VIP of the L7 move. Watches from his bowl.

customers.name: Market vendor
customers.description: Honey seller at the L8 Saturday market who trades a jar for a honey-lavender lemonade.

customers.name: Imogen Vance-Okoro
customers.description: Architect from the L9 job who sketches on everything, including latte foam.

customers.name: Ms. Agnes Pell
customers.description: Town librarian moving the library to its new branch at the L10 job. Speaks in a whisper; loves a quiet cappuccino.

customers.name: Juno Park
customers.description: Drummer in The Laundromats and a regular at Lou's record shop (L12); drops by the L11 loft. Mocha-powered and always late.

customers.name: Lou Marchetti
customers.description: Record shop owner at the L12 job; keeps a turntable spinning and the iced coffee on beat.

customers.name: Rosa Pemberton
customers.description: Florist with an orchid corner. Debuts in her L14 vanilla-latte event, then comes back as a regular-for-a-day; met Ray in this very line.

customers.name: Ray Pemberton
customers.description: Rosa's husband-to-be; first met her chatting in your queue. Plain-coffee man.

customers.name: Co-worker
customers.description: Friendly teammate in Dana's L16 glass suite who always tries the seasonal special first.

customers.name: Quiet critic
customers.description: Notebook-carrying critic who visits once you reach Rep 2 and 30 orders. Silent, then surprisingly kind.

customers.name: Marge 'Mile Marker' Holloway
customers.description: Dana's mentor and dispatcher; drops in at each office move to check on the shop.

customers.name: Queue customers (generic crowd)
customers.description: Generic background customers used for rush hour and weather crowds. Not a character; a crowd tag.

customers.name: Any customer (generic)
customers.description: Generic 'any customer' tag used by the review board. Not a character; a crowd tag.
